theorem PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_microscopic (hLS : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.UniformPrimeDivisorStatement)
  (hShorey : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.ShoreySquareProductStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) :
  Exists fun Lzero =>
    ∀ (L : Nat),
      GE.ge L Lzero →
        And
          (LE.le 0
            (HSub.hSub
              (HDiv.hDiv (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.microscopicProbability L)
                (HPow.hPow (Inv.inv 2) (Nat.primeCounting L)))
              1))
          (And
            (LE.le
              (HSub.hSub
                (HDiv.hDiv (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.microscopicProbability L)
                  (HPow.hPow (Inv.inv 2) (Nat.primeCounting L)))
                1)
              (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (1 / 256)) ↑(Nat.primeCounting L))))
            (And
              (LE.le (HSub.hSub 1 (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (1 / 256)) ↑(Nat.primeCounting L))))
                (MeasureTheory.Measure.real
                  (ProbabilityTheory.cond PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure
                    (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.microscopicEvent L))
                  (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.uniqueBorderEvent L)))
              (LE.le
                (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.measureTV
                  (ProbabilityTheory.cond PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure
                    (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.microscopicEvent L))
                  (ProbabilityTheory.cond PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure
                    (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.borderEvent L)))
                (HPow.hPow 2 (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (1 / 256)) ↑(Nat.primeCounting L))))))
name: PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_microscopic

theorem PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_mesoscopic (hShorey : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.ShoreySquareProductStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (hNR : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.DivisorLogBoundStatement)

  (hsmall :

theorem PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_prefix_quantitative (hStein : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
  (hLS : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.UniformPrimeDivisorStatement)
  (hShorey : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.ShoreySquareProductStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (hNR : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.DivisorLogBoundStatement)
  (betaMin betaMax epsilon eta : Real) (hb : LT.lt 0 betaMin) (hbb : LT.lt betaMin betaMax) (he : LT.lt 0 epsilon)
  (heta : LT.lt 0 eta) :
  Exists fun Mzero =>
    ∀ (M : Nat),
      GE.ge M Mzero →
        ∀ (L : Nat),
          LE.le (HMul.hMul betaMin (Real.log ↑M)) (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) →
            LE.le (HAdd.hAdd (↑L) 1) (HMul.hMul betaMax (Real.log ↑M)) →
              LE.le
                (PaperCV3Audit.massTV (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.prefixLaw M L)
                  (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.poissonMass (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate M L)))
                (HAdd.hAdd
                  (HAdd.hAdd
                    (HAdd.hAdd (HMul.hMul 43 (Min.min 1 (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.hardRate M L epsilon eta)))
                      (HMul.hMul 4
                        (Real.exp
                          (HMul.hMul (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul betaMin (Real.log 2)) 8))
                            (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑M) (Real.log (Real.log ↑M)))))))
                    (HPow.hPow (Inv.inv 2) (Nat.primeCounting L)))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (↑L) (HPow.hPow 2 L)))
name: PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_prefix_quantitative

theorem PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_prefix_critical (hStein : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
  (hLS : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.UniformPrimeDivisorStatement)
  (hShorey : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.ShoreySquareProductStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (hNR : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.DivisorLogBoundStatement)
  (C delta : Real) (hC : LE.le 0 C) (hd : LT.lt 0 delta) :
  Exists fun Mzero =>
    ∀ (M : Nat),
      GE.ge M Mzero →
        ∀ (L : Nat),
          PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.InRunLengthWindow C M L →
            And
              (LE.le
                (PaperCV3Audit.massTV (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.prefixLaw M L)
                  (PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.poissonMass (PaperCV3Audit.fullRate M L)))
                delta)
              (LE.le
                (abs
                  (HSub.hSub
                    (MeasureTheory.Measure.real PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure
                      (Set.ofPred fun omega => LT.lt (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.longestRun M omega) L))
                    (Real.exp (Neg.neg (HDiv.hDiv (↑M) (HPow.hPow 2 L))))))
                delta)
name: PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_prefix_critical

theorem PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_asymmetric_envelopes (hStein : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.ScalarSteinFactorsStatement)
  (hLS : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.UniformPrimeDivisorStatement)
  (hShorey : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.ShoreySquareProductStatement)
  (hPNT : PaperCV3Audit.Analysis.PrimeNumberTheoremRemainder) (hNR : PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.DivisorLogBoundStatement)
  (epsilon : Real) (he : LT.lt 0 epsilon) :
  Filter.Eventually
    (fun omega =>
      Filter.Eventually
        (fun M =>
          And
            (LE.le (HSub.hSub (HDiv.hDiv (Neg.neg (Real.log (Real.log (Real.log ↑M)))) (Real.log 2)) 4)
              (HSub.hSub (↑(PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.longestRun M omega)) (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑M) (Real.log 2))))
            (LE.le (HSub.hSub (↑(PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.longestRun M omega)) (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log ↑M) (Real.log 2)))
              (HAdd.hAdd
                (HAdd.hAdd (HDiv.hDiv (Real.log (Real.log ↑M)) (Real.log 2))
                  (HDiv.hDiv (HMul.hMul (HAdd.hAdd 1 epsilon) (Real.log (Real.log (Real.log ↑M)))) (Real.log 2)))
                (PaperCV3Audit.Boundary.upperAdditiveConstant epsilon))))
        Filter.atTop)
    (MeasureTheory.ae PaperCV3Audit.infiniteRademacherMeasure)
name: PaperCV3Audit.v3_boundary_asymmetric_envelopes
